newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Hot hooch to heat Swedish homes.
newsitem.headline: Hot hooch to heat Swedish homes.

text.p: Smuggled and bootleg vodka will be warming Swedes during the severe Scandinavian winter, though not in the usual way, customs officials said on Friday.
Thousands of gallons of confiscated spirits will be converted to methane gas to fire heating in the Swedish capital, where winter temperatures can fall to minus 30C (minus 22F).
"At least in that way it will be put to good use," Borje Enoksson of the customs authority told reporters.
The 180,000 litres (40,000 gallons) of smuggled and home- distilled vodka confiscated in the Stockholm region this year has forced customs to rent expensive secure storage warehouses.
